tasks.intent:
Implement spec/npu.md under rtl/ only. Develop and repair using
python3 tools/smoke.py; the checker is immutable. Write only rtl/** and build/**.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references or
parent projects. Do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
Use the installed Icarus/Verilator and Python. No external IP is permitted in
either treatment. The total trial budget, including planning and checking,
is 600 seconds. Finish with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"nebula_npu_dot4"}}.

brief.objective: Deliver fresh, original, synthesizable SystemVerilog for nebula_npu_dot4 that satisfies the immutable spec/npu.md contract for project platform-4.
deliverables: rtl: rtl.snapshot, schema_version 1, containing rtl/** and module nebula_npu_dot4.
responsibilities: Implement ports clk, rst_n, req_valid, req_ready, req_a[31:0], req_b[31:0], rsp_valid, rsp_ready, rsp_data[31:0], and kill.
Compute the signed INT32 sum of four signed INT8 products, with lane 0 in bits 7:0, four parallel multipliers, and products widened before reduction.
Accept requests at edge n when req_valid && req_ready; assert the result after edge n+2; hold response valid and data until consumed; permit at most one outstanding operation.
Ensure reset and kill dominate acceptance and output, cancel pending work, and permit correct recovery.
Develop and check within the total 600-second trial budget, including planning and checking, using the immutable public checker.
exclusions: No hidden accumulator, memory, saturation, rounding, or external IP.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references, or parent projects; do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
Read only spec/**, tb/**, tools/smoke.py, rtl/**, and build/**; write only rtl/** and build/**. Keep source records and the checker immutable.
Use only the permitted tools: python3, git, iverilog, vvp, and verilator.
completion_criteria: The delivered RTL satisfies all specified arithmetic, interface, latency, backpressure, reset, kill, and recovery requirements.

Run the common-public-smoke L1 hard gate with python3 tools/smoke.py, timeout 120 seconds, expecting NPU_SMOKE_PASS; report any gate failure as public_smoke_failed under the prescribed on_failure=report policy.
Deliver the RTL snapshot and required final marker within the 600-second total trial budget.
collaboration: Provide the rtl delivery to task:npu-pilot-4:audit for independent public verification.

tasks.intent: Independently replay public checks on the selected design Delivery. Report genuine passed or failed; no RTL/checker changes.

brief.objective: Independently verify the selected RTL delivery for project platform-4 by replaying the immutable public checker and retaining its actual verdict.
deliverables: report: verification.report, schema_version 1, containing build/audit.json and build/audit.log.
responsibilities: Audit the rtl.snapshot supplied by the predefined design dependency.
Execute python3 tools/audit.py and retain the genuine public-check verdict and supporting log.
Read only rtl/**, tb/**, and tools/**; write only build/**; use only python3, iverilog, and vvp.
exclusions: Do not change RTL, testbenches, or the checker.
Do not substitute an inferred verdict for the actual checker result or conceal a failed result.
Do not add hard gates or feedback routes.
completion_criteria: The predefined command python3 tools/audit.py has independently replayed the public checks on the selected design delivery.
Both build/audit.json and build/audit.log exist and accurately retain the actual passed or failed verdict and supporting evidence.
No additional hard gate applies; a genuine failed verdict remains a valid audit result.
collaboration: Consume the rtl output from task:npu-pilot-4:design without modifying that delivery.
